items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: take a man like Joe Hodden and he can answer more than anything he asks.

ctx.x: Well, I guess that's the man they ask, huh? Yeah. You've been a lot longer than me.
All right. Ain't like them professors, you know. Some of them questions I can answer, but take a man like Joe Hodden and he can answer more than anything he asks.
Well, I tell you, I'm lucky I can read the name on the top of a sheet of music, much less the notes.
